headline: Microsoft (MSFT) Deepens AI Partnerships As $500 Billion Chip Funding Wave Builds
summary: Citadel Securities projects up to $500b in debt issuance by 2028 to fund AI chip infrastructure, with Microsoft expected to be a major participant in this build out. Microsoft is expanding AI driven product integrations across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure with companies such as LegalZoom, Paychex, and ArcelorMittal.
